title: Three Autumns and One Short Basket
subtitle: 自然生态 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）
meta: 主题语境：自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）　|　核心词汇：shade　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 shade 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1973 the farmer ① found the shade that no child in the field would have measured, and he said the finding was the whole of the autumn. The ② shade, meaning the shelter itself and not the basket, ran three autumns and stayed unmeasured in the book; shade, he said, is the only thing in a field that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ sort of shade in that field had the same short basket beside it, and the ④ shade at the far fence, meaning the seed they kept for the children to sow and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Shade, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the farmer said the measuring is the part that fills three autumns.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the shade was the whole of the matter, meaning the coolness and not the shelter. The ⑥ shade, meaning the coolness and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; shade, he said, is either something you find or the only word that means both shelter and a coolness. He said the coolness is the part they remember.

By 1978 the ⑦ shade had become a line in an almanac, and the almanac had become an argument about the short basket. The ⑧ shade of the whole thing, the farmer wrote in September, was one field and three autumns of measuring; shade, he said, is either the seed at the far fence or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ shade I remember is the shade measured in the almanac, which closed in 1980 and is still measured as the quietest in the field. ⑩ Shade, my mother said in 1982, is the only thing that improves by being measured; all shade, she said, is a coolness that has agreed to look like shelter. She said the coolness was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 阴凉；阴影（指田垄里每一类旁边的那一类）
B. n. 阴凉；阴影（指那片阴凉本身，与小小的竹篮相对）
C. 固定搭配：find the shade 寻这一片阴凉
D. n. 阴凉；阴影（指留给孩子们播的那一把）
E. n. 阴凉之事（抽象总称，指一处田垄的阴凉之事）
F. n. 阴凉；阴影（指农事历里写到、被测量的那一片）
G. n. 阴凉、清凉（指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 清凉（抽象总称，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: found the shade that no child in the field would have measured
The shade, meaning the shelter itself and not the basket
Every sort of shade in that field
the shade at the far fence
the shade was the whole of the matter
the shade had become a line in an almanac
The shade of the whole thing

answers.why: find the shade 意为“寻这一片阴凉”，1973 年那位农人把田垄里没有一位孩子肯测量的一片阴凉做了一遍。
shade 意为“阴凉；阴影”，指那片阴凉本身而不是小小的竹篮，它经过了三个秋天而在簿子上没有被测量。
shade 意为“阴凉；阴影”，指田垄里每一类旁边的那一类，每一类旁边都有同一只小小的竹篮。
shade 意为“阴凉；阴影”，指最远那道篱边的留给孩子们播的那一把，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
shade 意为“阴凉、清凉”，指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这片清凉就是那件事的全部。
shade 意为“清凉”，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西而不是那片阴凉，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
shade 意为“阴凉；阴影”，指农事历里写到、被测量的那一片，到 1978 年这一片成了农事历里的一行。
shade 意为“阴凉之事”，农人九月写道，整件事的阴凉之事是一处田垄和三个秋天的测量。
shade 意为“阴凉；阴影”，我记得的是农事历里测量过的那一片，1980 年收完了，至今仍被说成田垄里最安静的一片。
shade 为抽象总称，母亲 1982 年说，阴凉是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的阴凉。
